attacks.name: Tail Whip
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Push|: If the target character is Size 3 or less, before |!damage| is dealt it may be pushed away from this character |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Cold Blooded
steps: If this attack deals |!damage|, after this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§bleed§Bleed| and |§slow§Slow| special conditions.

superPowers.name: Biochemical Breakthrough
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature or an enemy character, both of Size 3 or less and within |!range| 2, and throw it |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Thick Hide
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.
